why: Issue #915. The gallery workbench's closing tag moves below the DEV badge, so the badge is inside that pane: its register entry -- the badge belongs to no panel -- is no longer true. One hunk because the two are adjacent in the template. Killed by the badge case, whose out-of-pane population empties, and by the fold, which loses the badge as a subject. Not a gap this file closes alone: six of `hud.developer-mode.test.ts`'s 11 cases also fail (measured), because a badge inside a pane is hidden whenever that pane is, while its own 'not in either walk' check reads only the panel, Developer Tools, Settings and About. The badge case is the one that states the entry.
killedBy: the accessibility exception register (issue #915) registers exactly five exceptions, each for its reason
the accessibility exception register (issue #915) holds the DEV badge as the one control outside every pane
